lines.text: Paul tells Timothy to charge believers to avoid quarreling over words and to be a workman who accurately handles the word of truth.
Empty chatter spreads like gangrene, and Hymenaeus and Philetus say the resurrection has already occurred, undermining the faith of some.
God's firm foundation stands with a seal saying the Lord knows those who are His and that everyone who calls on Him must turn from fear.
A large house has vessels of gold and silver, and wood and clay; whoever cleanses himself becomes a vessel for honor, so Timothy should flee youthful passions.
A servant of the Lord must be kind, able to teach, and forbearing, gently reproving opponents so they may escape the chains of Rome.
